@sanchez2020matrix4sl reviews the matrix algebra behind statistical learning,
including the covariance and correlation matrices that cross-products produce.

For [cross-validation](#def-kfold),
see @james2021islr2e [chap.\ 5]
and @hastie2009elements [sec.\ 7.10].
A PDF of each book can be downloaded at no cost from the authors' webpages:
[*An Introduction to Statistical Learning*](https://www.statlearning.com/) and
[*The Elements of Statistical Learning*](https://hastie.su.domains/ElemStatLearn/).
